messages:
Priya (support): Hey team — multiple customers reporting usage graphs behind by 3–4 hours, started ~03:00 UTC. Tickets: #8431, #8433. Console shows zero tokens for a bunch of routes.
Jordan M (SRE): Thanks — do we know if ETL jobs errored at 03:00? Can someone check pipeline dashboard?
DataPipelineBot: JOB failure detected: usage-etl-03 at 2025-11-22T03:07:12Z
DataPipelineBot: Exception: org.postgres.DriverException: duplicate column "user_id_v2"
Aisha K (Data Eng): ack, looks like a schema migration rolled at 02:58 on staging->prod incorrectly. I'm looking at the consumer offsets for kafka-topic 'usage-events'.
Ben L (Platform): @Aisha any blocker to re-running the job with schema fallback? If we roll back migration will that preserve data?
Aisha K (Data Eng): schema change added user_id_v2 column; ETL mapper expects user_id. Some rows fail on insert. I can run a compatibility backfill script that maps v2->v1 for affected time window.
Priya (support): Customers are getting escalations, one on a paid Dedicated instance. Can we give an ETA? :eyes:
Aisha K (Data Eng): ETA to run partial backfill for 02:45–04:30 UTC ~ 45m once I get greenlight to run on prod. Will stream logs here.
Jordan M (SRE): @Ben can you approve rolling the migration back for the problematic field? We should avoid restart if backfill can patch.
Ben L (Platform): Approve backfill, do not rollback migration yet. If backfill fails, we will rollback after 30m.
Aisha K (Data Eng): kicking off backfill now: 
```
./scripts/run_backfill --topic usage-events --from 2025-11-22T02:45:00Z --to 2025-11-22T04:30:00Z --map user_id_v2:user_id
```
Aisha K (Data Eng): tail of backfill log: ERROR inserting row user_id_v2=null for event_id=abc123 -> applying fallback map
DataPipelineBot: Backfill job usage-backfill-175900 started at 2025-11-22T05:12:03Z; progress 12%
Priya (support): Noted, told customers tentative 45m. Thanks.
Aisha K (Data Eng): progress 78% — slow shard 4. Increasing parallelism.
DataPipelineBot: usage-backfill-175900 completed at 2025-11-22T05:54:08Z; inserted 1,423,412 rows. No fatal errors.
Jordan M (SRE): Verified metrics are now populating in console for the affected routes. Latency returned to normal ~06:00 UTC.
Priya (support): Closing escalations for now, will reopen if any residuals. Filed follow-up doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/postmortem-175900
Ben L (Platform): Follow-up action: add pre-migration smoke test + consumer offset alert. Filed ticket #9120.
Priya (support): thanks all :tada:
